<p class="page-intro">My policy work translates economic research into choices about energy systems, public finance, and long-run growth. It is grounded in sustained collaboration with governments and researchers rather than one-off commentary.</p>

<div class="policy-principles">
<div>
<span class="agenda-number">01</span>
<h3>Technology and AI</h3>
<p>How artificial intelligence and new technologies reshape productivity, labour markets, and the path of structural transformation.</p>
</div>
<div>
<span class="agenda-number">02</span>
<h3>Energy systems</h3>
<p>Pricing, contracts, subsidies, metering, utility performance, and the transition to reliable low-carbon power.</p>
</div>
<div>
<span class="agenda-number">03</span>
<h3>Growth strategy</h3>
<p>Productivity, exports, cities, structural transformation, and the institutional foundations of investment.</p>
</div>
<div>
<span class="agenda-number">04</span>
<h3>Climate and public finance</h3>
<p>Adaptation, critical minerals, fiscal reform, and the distributional consequences of economic transition.</p>
</div>
</div>

## Government engagement

<div class="engagement-grid">
<div class="engagement-card">
<p class="paper-meta">Pakistan</p>
<h3>Energy, fiscal reform, and industrial policy</h3>
<p>Advice to senior federal decision-makers on electricity tariffs, power-purchase agreements, industrial competitiveness, tax proposals, and macroeconomic reform.</p>
</div>

<div class="engagement-card">
<p class="paper-meta">Ethiopia</p>
<h3>National energy policy</h3>
<p>National energy policy, diffusion of solar, and utility reforms, including the evidence base for smart-meter deployment.</p>
</div>

<div class="engagement-card">
<p class="paper-meta">Ghana</p>
<h3>Electricity and industrial activity</h3>
<p>Electricity sector losses, outages, and industrial activity, and their effects on firm productivity and agglomeration.</p>
</div>

<div class="engagement-card">
<p class="paper-meta">Jordan</p>
<h3>Utility tariff reform</h3>
<p>Water and electricity tariff reforms.</p>
</div>

<div class="engagement-card">
<p class="paper-meta">India</p>
<h3>Climate and structural transformation</h3>
<p>Policies for climate adaptation and structural transformation.</p>
</div>

<div class="engagement-card">
<p class="paper-meta">Myanmar</p>
<h3>Electrification and urban growth</h3>
<p>Research and policy support on the National Electrification Plan, energy pricing, infrastructure constraints, and the development of Yangon.</p>
</div>
</div>
